    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrdersMerge" name="Orders placed"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FirstBatch" name="First parts arrive">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_FirstBatch" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BuildMerge" name="Parts available for building"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Build" name="Build with parts"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockLevel" name="Stock of a single part compared to limits 5 and 3?" default="Flow_StockOk"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ComplaintMail" name="Write complaint mail to friends about web shops" messageRef="Msg_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ComplaintSent" name="Complaint mail sent"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts" messageRef="Msg_Order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Stock checked"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NextBatch" name="Next parts batch arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_NextBatch" messageRef="Msg_PartsBatch"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="Start_Project" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Offers" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_RecordOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Compare" sourceRef="Task_RecordOffers" targetRef="Task_CompareOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateList" sourceRef="Task_CompareOffers" targetRef="Task_CreateOrderList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToSingleShopCheck" sourceRef="Task_CreateOrderList" targetRef="Gateway_SingleShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShop" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShop" targetRef="Task_OrderOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enoughAtOneShop == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShops" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SingleShop" targetRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OneShopMerge" sourceRef="Task_OrderOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SeveralShopsMerge" sourceRef="Task_OrderSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitFirstBatch" sourceRef="Gateway_OrdersMerge" targetRef="Event_FirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatchToBuild" sourceRef="Event_FirstBatch" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartBuilding" sourceRef="Gateway_BuildMerge" targetRef="Task_Build"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_Build" targetRef="Gateway_StockLevel"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" name="Stock is zero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ComplaintMail">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock == 0}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow3" name="Stock below 3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock > 0 && stock < 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow5" name="Stock below 5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${stock >= 3 && stock < 5}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockOk" name="Stock sufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_StockLevel" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ComplaintEnd" sourceRef="Task_ComplaintMail" targetRef="End_ComplaintSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastestMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapestMerge" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitNextBatch" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Event_NextBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextBatchToBuild" sourceRef="Event_NextBatch" targetRef="Gateway_BuildMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
